overview: Host John Petrella provided updates on local sports championships and school donations while highlighting upcoming holiday events. He also announced a recruitment drive for snow shovelers and a public meeting on Salem Street zoning.

items.title: Medford Sports Recognitions
items.summary: John Petrella congratulated the high school and middle school Mustangs for their respective Greater Boston League championship titles.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Donation
items.summary: The Music Drives Us organization donated $60,000 worth of musical instruments and equipment to the Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Holiday Events and Toy Drives
items.summary: The host announced several seasonal activities, including a community holiday concert on December 14th, multiple city-wide toy drives, and the SantaCon on the Mystic festival.

items.title: Snow Shoveler Recruitment
items.summary: The city is seeking volunteer or paid snow shovelers for the winter season to assist elderly residents, with applications managed through the Director of Elderly Affairs.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Meeting
items.summary: Petrella urged residents to attend a City Council Planning and Permitting Committee meeting on December 11th regarding zoning changes for the Salem Street corridor.
